title: Abraham Lincoln
summary: Lincoln signed the District of Columbia Compensated Emancipation Act on April 16, 1862, issued the Emancipation Proclamation effective January 1, 1863, and approved the joint resolution sending the Thirteenth Amendment to the states on February 1, 1865.

heroImage.alt: Photographic portrait of Abraham Lincoln, head and shoulders
heroImage.credit: Alexander Gardner studio, February 1865 (O-77 sitting), via Wikimedia Commons.

items.text: April 16, 1862: signed the District of Columbia Compensated Emancipation Act.

runs.text: None of the sources cited here shows that Lincoln ever enslaved anyone.
